# Patriot Software

> > Patriot Software provides affordable, integrated accounting and payroll solutions designed specifically for small businesses in the USA.

Patriot Software offers cloud-based accounting, payroll, HR, and time tracking tools with seamless integrations for employee benefits, retirement plans, and workers' compensation. The platform is built to simplify financial management and compliance for small business owners.

## Payroll Add-ons & Integrations

- [Time & Attendance Software | Employee Timekeeping & Time Cards](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/payroll/add-ons/time-attendance): Patriot Time add-on for employee timekeeping, time cards, and PTO tracking
- [HR Software | Human Resources Management for Small Business](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/payroll/add-ons/human-resources): Patriot HR add-on for employee management, compliance, and document handling
- [Payroll With Employee Health Benefits | Patriot Software](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/payroll/employee-health-benefits): Employee health benefits integration with payroll via SimplyInsured partnership
- [401(k) Payroll Integration for Small Business | Patriot Software](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/payroll/401k): 401(k) retirement plan integration with automated payroll deductions via Vestwell
- [Workers' Comp | Payroll With Free Workers' Comp Integration](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/payroll/workers-comp): Workers' compensation insurance integration with ERGO NEXT for payroll
